purpose: Transforms input dictionary fields to output dictionary fields using a schema mapping map.
capability: Maps keys from source dict to target dict based on a key mapping specification.

input.mapping: dict (mapping of target_key -> source_key or transform rule)

interface: index.py -> transform_data_mapping(data: dict, mapping: dict) -> dict
composition: Can be combined with query-json-path and validate-schema-dict.
failure_behavior: Missing source keys map to None.
